t: 10 reasons to buy a vacation home + pros and cons | Pacaso
s: March 12, 2021 - You can keep all the comforts and necessities — clothes, toiletries, outdoor gear and more — at your vacation home so you can get away from it all at a moment’s notice.Unlike relying on reviews to choose a hotel room or short-term rental, you always know exactly what to expect when you arrive at your vacation home. Buying a second home in a destination you love allows you to experience the place in a whole new way and truly become a community member.Your vacation home could become your primary residence once you retire, but you can start enjoying it and building equity long before it’s time to turn in your employee badge.
